topics.topic: Whether a failed upload-head read counts as owner-request arrival for session admission and idle-time renewal
questions: When the upload head cannot be completely read, has the owner request arrived for session admission and idle-time renewal?
When reading an upload head fails before the head has been read, has the owner request arrived for purposes of admission and restarting the session's idle period?
When reading the upload head fails, has the owner request arrived for session admission and idle-time restart, or has it not arrived because the head was not successfully read?

quotes:
A surface whose reading of a body
fails — a form, a service request, an upload's head — hands the request on
all the same, with no CSRF value and no values: the session check admits the
owner's, restarting the session's 30 minutes when it is valid (A13 rule 2),

Validity is
   checked when a request arrives (A04 rule 6, stage 1) — an upload, whose
   form sends its CSRF value before its file (A19 rule 4), arrives when that
   head, at most the imported `UPLOAD_FORM_HEAD_MAX_BYTES` constant, has been
   read (owner, 2026-11-17);
judgement.divergence: A failed upload-head read either reaches owner-session admission and restarts the idle period, or does not constitute an arrived request and leaves the idle period unchanged; the owner notices whether a subsequent request is admitted.
judgement.why: State 4 says a failed upload-head read is handed to the session check and renews the session, while A13 says an upload arrives only when its head has been read.

None of its own: it refuses nothing. An operation name that is not one of
A09 rule 2's reaches `operations`, which refuses it at stage (1) as outside
the service's rights (`not_permitted`, `outside_service_rights`), whatever
token it carries once the token is valid; inputs that are not of the wire

value of another shape than its field's — are answered stage (1) first and
then `invalid_request` (`outside_closed_list`) at stage (4). A declared
field left out is not a wire-format failure: it reaches the operation as
absent, and its module answers it (`missing_value`, A02). Every refusal is
`operations`'.
judgement.why: State 5 says an unreadable service body reaches `operations.perform_service_operation`, undergoes stage (1), and is then refused at stage (4) as `invalid_request` with `outside_closed_list`, rather than being treated as merely absent declared fields.
